title: 通胀数字骗了你？：油价稳定后，债市价值重估
speaker: Jason Payne

segments.en: For us, I think the way that we would see it is, again, I do believe that there is an opportunity here in terms of the bond investment products and for fixed income.
segments.zh: 对我们而言，我们认为，在债券产品和固定收益领域确实存在机会。

segments.en: At what valuation and when, I think for what is worth incrementally for us, we've been more biased to favor the value creation in terms of this term premium.
segments.zh: 至于在什么估值水平和时机上，我们认为，我们更倾向于看好期限溢价带来的价值创造。

segments.en: And a lot of it then is, of course, positive as we discuss on the higher oil price.
segments.zh: 当然，其中很大一部分与我们讨论的油价上行有关。

segments.en: So I know it doesn't look like it today, but we should think about what happens when the base effects on CPI normalize in the next year.
segments.zh: 我知道今天看起来并非如此，但我们应该思考明年CPI基数效应正常化后会发生什么。

segments.en: And what happens if you reach a saturation point where oil prices reach a better equilibrium, that is a very attractive macro setup with valuations to boot for global bonds generally.
segments.zh: 如果油价达到饱和点并实现更好的均衡，那将是非常有吸引力的宏观环境，加上估值支撑，对全球债券整体而言。
